Fact.Name: Received Forms 1099-SB
Fact.Description: Forms 1099-SB received for the 2025 return, one item per issuer notice.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB calendar year
Fact.Description: The calendar year shown in the header of this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB VOID checkbox
Fact.Description: The VOID box of Copy A, the issuer's copy filed with the IRS. The seller's Copy B has no VOID box (its header prints only CORRECTED (if checked)), so a seller leaves this unanswered. Read by nothing: a notice is reviewed whether or not this box is answered, and no answer here removes a reportable policy sale from the return.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB CORRECTED checkbox
Fact.Description: Whether the issuer marked this Form 1099-SB CORRECTED.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB issuer name, address, and phone
Fact.Description: The issuer's name, mailing address, and telephone number from this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB issuer TIN
Fact.Description: The issuer's taxpayer identification number (TIN) from this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB seller TIN
Fact.Description: The seller's taxpayer identification number (TIN) from this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB seller name
Fact.Description: The seller's name from this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB seller street address
Fact.Description: The seller's street address from this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB seller city, region, country, and postal code
Fact.Description: The seller's city, state or province, country, and postal code from this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB life insurance policy number
Fact.Description: The life insurance policy number for the transferred contract on this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB box 1 investment in contract
Fact.Description: Box 1 investment in the life insurance contract for this seller on Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB box 2 surrender amount
Fact.Description: Box 2 surrender amount for the life insurance contract on this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB issuer information contact
Fact.Description: The issuer's information contact name, address, and telephone number from this Form 1099-SB.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-SB tax treatment unavailable
Fact.Description: A Form 1099-SB is present whose policy-transfer tax treatment cannot yet be determined for the 2025 return. Every entered notice counts: the seller copy has no VOID box, so no answer removes a notice from this review.
